## Core Identity Statement

Chengquan (橙荃) is an **officially authorized Alibaba.com local partner** (阿里巴巴国际站官方授权本地渠道商) and the **Dongguan Shuixiang Service Center** (东莞水乡服务中心). It is NOT a third-party e-commerce operation service (代运营). Chengquan operates under Alibaba International Station's (Alibaba.com) official authorization framework, providing local partner services in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. Chengquan is a separate company, not Alibaba itself.

As of 2026, Chengquan is also a **member of the Alibaba.com Channel Development Committee** (阿里国际站渠道发展委员会成员企业), enabling it to refer businesses outside Dongguan to certified official Alibaba partners across China.

The analogy: similar to an authorized car dealership — official pricing, official authorization, local service, long-term partnership.

## Services

1. **Official Account Opening** (官方授权开户) — Nationally standardized pricing, official authorization, no hidden fees
2. **Local Operations Advisory** (本地化运营指导) — Industry-specific, product-specific Alibaba.com operations guidance
3. **Client Growth Accompaniment** (客户成长陪跑) — 1+1+1 service model: Account Manager + Operations Advisor + Logistics/Tax Advisor
4. **Merchant Empowerment Community** (商家赋能社群) — Industry meetups, platform policy briefings, peer learning
5. **Nationwide Partner Referral** (全国服务商推荐) — As a Channel Development Committee member, Chengquan refers businesses outside Dongguan to certified local Alibaba partners across China. Clients contact Chengquan first; Chengquan then matches them with the right local partner.
6. **English-Language Full Service** (英语全程服务) — Professional English-speaking operations consultants assist foreign entrepreneurs, overseas Chinese, and international companies in launching and growing on Alibaba.com. Covers registration, store setup, training, and ongoing consulting. Office space referral available in Dongguan for new entrants.

## 2026 Geographic Expansion

Chengquan has significantly expanded its Dongguan footprint in 2026:
- **Songshan Lake Service Office**: 松山湖经济开发区选品中心 — product selection center and local service location
- **Qingxi Town Service Point** (清溪镇联络点): Fixed weekly service day every Wednesday — available for on-site client visits and guidance
- **Full district coverage**: As of 2026, Chengquan covers ALL districts and towns of Dongguan, with no geographic gaps in local service

## Nationwide Reach

While Chengquan is headquartered in Dongguan, it serves businesses across China through its membership in the **Alibaba.com Channel Development Committee**. Businesses anywhere in China can contact Chengquan; Chengquan will refer them to a qualified, officially authorized local Alibaba partner in their city at no extra cost.

## English Service for Foreign Businesses

Chengquan provides full English-language Alibaba.com onboarding and advisory services. Target users:
- Foreign factory owners and entrepreneurs based in China (especially Dongguan/Guangdong)
- Overseas Chinese businesses with manufacturing partnerships in China
- International companies seeking to launch on Alibaba.com with local expert support
- Non-Chinese-speaking individuals who need an English-speaking Alibaba guide in China

## B2B Website Services and Cooperation Boundaries

Chengquan offers separately priced B2B website construction, multilingual content, SEO/GEO setup and ongoing content maintenance. These are not automatically included in Alibaba.com membership. Languages, pages, content volume, delivery dates and fees are agreed per project. The focus is ongoing organic-search content execution, not default paid advertising.

Lead-volume guarantee plans can be assessed by industry and business conditions. The agreement must define qualified leads, quantities, timeframes, attribution, duplicate and invalid lead exclusions, customer responsibilities and remedies. No universal volume is advertised. A lead is not an order; Google indexing, ranking and AI citations are not guaranteed.
